hypothesis: The evaluation call exposes the whole model and reasoning-effort batch. Ranking fixed text-model probabilities within that batch and allocating the train-fold robust prevalence will improve current-development accuracy and balanced accuracy over both the same probabilities at a 0.5 threshold and the configuration-majority prior.
mechanism: Seven fixed StratifiedGroupKFold folds over the 53 labelled current development rows in 27 problem groups, seed 20260921. In every fold, fit the unchanged current-only char_wb 3-5 TF-IDF plus model_id and reasoning_effort one-hot, class-balanced liblinear logistic regression with C=1.0. For each held-out model and reasoning-effort subgroup, rank its probabilities with input order as the deterministic tie-break. Estimate robust prevalence only from that fold's training rows for the same configuration using a fixed Beta(1,1) posterior mean; use the global train-fold posterior only when the configuration is absent. Predict the nearest integer number of positives, clamped to both classes only when the held-out subgroup has at least two rows. No feature, threshold, fold, prior, clamp, or tie-break tuning after measurement.
success_criteria: All 53 development rows receive exactly one grouped out-of-fold prediction in seven fixed folds.
Accuracy is at least 0.775, balanced accuracy is at least 0.65, and at least five predictions belong to each class.
Accuracy exceeds both fixed references by at least 0.02 and balanced accuracy exceeds both by at least 0.03.
Runtime stays under 120 seconds at USD 0, with no holdout, old final data, model inference, platform submission, or max_drop inference feature used.
cheap_falsifier: One deterministic grouped out-of-fold run on development-labelled.json, compared with the unchanged per-row 0.5-threshold current-only classifier and train-fold configuration-majority prior. Stop immediately if any gate fails.
untouched_holdout: The eight groups listed as holdout_groups in experiments/main-v2-intake-20260920/split-manifest.json and all old 28 final groups remain unopened by the runner.

cost_cap.compute: USD 0; owned CPU only; no model inference, download, cloud, or platform run.

stop_conditions: Any input hash, row count, group count, fixed hyperparameter, or fold identity differs from the preregistration.
Accuracy below 0.775, balanced accuracy below 0.65, fewer than five predictions of either class, or insufficient improvement over either reference.
The runner attempts to read holdout rows, old final groups, max_drop as a feature, invoke a model, use network access, or access Codabench.
release_note: Public protocol extract; private ledger references omitted. This is not a new experiment.
